team2-default.source: --team2; replaced at runtime by the lead school's second color

team-fallback-1.source: team tag --c1 fallback when an NFL team has no colors

display.purpose: The CFB SUNDAYS wordmark in the band only.

title.purpose: Team-side headings in an open game (h3).

menu.purpose: Rail tabs (18px on phones); band meta at 15px/800/0.05em; selected chips at 15px/800/width 74.

action.purpose: Gold buttons; 20px for the full-width add button.

count.purpose: Gold per-game count of your players; 28px on phones.

body.purpose: All reading text; 16px on phones; tabular numerals on body.

themes.mechanism: Tokens on :root; dark set under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme=light]) and again under :root[data-theme=dark]; color-scheme set to match.
themes.fixed: Score bug palette (bug-*) and gold are identical in both themes.

bandVariables.--team2-ink: inkFor(--team2); not declared on :root, consumed with fallback #1b1400

teamColors.applied: applyTeam() sets the four band variables on document.documentElement inside document.startViewTransition (skipped on first paint and under reduced motion)
teamColors.prohibition: Colors only. No school, NFL or video game logos or wordmarks.

shadows.name: band-bevel
shadows.purpose: Chrome hairlines on the band's top and bottom edges.

shadows.name: band-gloss
shadows.purpose: Split gloss overlay on the band (background, not shadow).

shadows.name: gold-rule
shadows.purpose: Menu rail top hairline and 3px gold line beneath it.

shadows.name: score-bug-hover
shadows.purpose: Score bug hover and focus: gold ring plus deeper drop.

shadows.name: chip-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected chips and the active week button (with a .6 top highlight).

motion.name: ease-menu
motion.purpose: The one easing curve: tab bar, band wipe, score bug nudge, easter egg.

motion.name: selection-bar-slide
motion.purpose: Gold bar morphs from the old tab to the new one (document.startViewTransition on tab click).

motion.name: team-select-wipe
motion.value: ::view-transition-new(band) wipe 0.5s ease-menu; clip-path polygon(0 0,0 0,-12% 100%,-12% 100%) to polygon(0 0,112% 0,100% 100%,-12% 100%)
motion.purpose: Band takes on the lead school's colors with a slanted left-to-right wipe; root cross-fade disabled.

motion.name: score-bug-hover
motion.purpose: Score bug nudges right with a gold ring.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Recap, contact and ranking-row disclosure markers.

motion.name: egg-in
motion.value: scale(.92) to none with opacity, .35s (screen) / .5s (answer) ease-menu
motion.purpose: Easter egg championship screen, only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: JS skips startViewTransition when (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) matches; CSS sets animation:none on all view-transition pseudo-elements
motion.purpose: Motion is opt-out by the OS setting.

components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:6px 16px;background:var(--rail,#0e1830);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 3px 0 var(--gold,#ffc629)} .ds-tab{position:relative;isolation:isolate;font-family:Saira,system-ui,sans-serif;font-stretch:72%;font-weight:700;font-style:italic;font-size:17px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;background:none;border:none;color:var(--rail-ink,#c7d2e8);padding:7px 14px;cursor:pointer} .ds-hl{position:absolute;inset:2px 0;z-index:-1;background:var(--gold,#ffc629);transform:skewX(-14deg);border-radius:2px;opacity:0;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6),inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)} .ds-tab.ds-on{color:var(--gold-ink,#1b1400)} .ds-tab.ds-on .ds-hl{opacity:1} .ds-tab:not(.ds-on):hover{color:#fff} .ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#ffc629);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
CFB Sundays is dressed as an early-2000s console college football menu. Picking a school is picking your team on the select screen: the header band, its slanted second-color stripe and the email panel header take on the lead school's colors with a slanted wipe, and a single gold selection bar marks where you are. The ground under it is cool steel in light mode and deep stadium navy in dark mode; the menu rail is always near-black navy. Game rows are broadcast score bugs that stay dark in both themes.

The world is glossy and beveled, never glowing. Depth comes from chrome hairline highlights along top edges, darker bevels along bottom edges, and a split gloss gradient on the band. Everything that is a choice (tabs, chips, week buttons, team tags) is a slanted parallelogram. Type is one variable family, Saira, pushed narrow, heavy and italic for anything that is a label on the menu, and set at near-normal width for reading. Numbers are tabular everywhere.

Team identity is carried by color alone: two-tone swatches, two-tone team tags and the reskinned band. There are no school, NFL or video game logos or wordmarks anywhere in the system. Density is a working tool's density: compact rows, 14px rhythm, one 760px column, built for a phone during a Sunday game.
keyCharacteristics: Team-color band with a glossy split gradient and a slanted second-color stripe at right, recolored at runtime from the lead school.
Near-black menu rail with slanted italic tab labels and one gold selection bar that slides between tabs.
Steel (light) or stadium-navy (dark) ground; the menu rail and score bugs stay dark in both.
Slanted parallelogram shapes for every selectable control, counter-skewed so the text stays upright.
Saira variable at narrow width (70 to 74) for display and menu labels, near-normal width (96) for body; tabular numerals throughout.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold means "selected, focused, press this, or this is your number." Only one gold selection bar exists in the rail, one gold week button in the week bar, one gold option in the dropdown. Gold is never a decorative fill or a section color.

rules.name: The Colors-Only Rule
rules.body: Team identity is expressed only through color: `--team1`/`--team2`/`--team-ink` on the band, `--c1`/`--c2`/`--ci` on team tags, selected chips and swatch dots. No school, NFL or video game logos or wordmarks, ever.

rules.name: The Computed Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on any team color takes its ink from the luminance function, never a hand-picked value, so every school in `colors.json` stays legible.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Narrow (width 70 to 74) is for things the menu says: display, headings, tabs, chips, buttons, scores. Reading text stays at width 96. Never set a paragraph narrow.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the body, so every score, count and stat column lines up. Don't turn it off.

rules.name: The Italic Is Motion Rule
rules.body: Italic belongs to display and control labels, where it matches the slanted shapes. Body text is upright.

rules.name: The Chrome Edge Rule
rules.body: Raised menu surfaces carry a 1px white inner highlight on top and a darker inner line at the bottom. That pair, not a large blurred shadow, is what makes something look like a menu button.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No colored outer glows, no neon, no blur halos. Gold appears as a solid ring or bar.

dos: **Do** take team colors only from `site/colors.json` at runtime and route them through `--team1`/`--team2`/`--team-ink` (band) or `--c1`/`--c2`/`--ci` (tags, chips, dots).
**Do** compute text ink on any team color with the luminance function (dark `#0c1526` above 0.36 luminance, otherwise white).
**Do** skew selectable controls (-12deg, or -14deg for the tab bar) and counter-skew their text so it stays upright.
**Do** keep one gold selection per group: one tab, one week, one dropdown option.
**Do** give raised menu surfaces the chrome edge pair: a 1px white inner highlight on top, a darker inner line at the bottom.
**Do** keep score bugs dark navy in both themes.
**Do** use Saira at width 70 to 74 for labels and headings and width 96 for reading text, with tabular numerals.
**Do** gate every animation and view transition behind a reduced-motion check.
donts: **Don't** use school, NFL or video game logos, wordmarks or helmet art. Colors only.
**Don't** add colored outer glows or neon effects. Gold is a solid bar, fill or ring.
**Don't** use gold for decoration, section headers or large fills that are not a selection, focus, primary action or your player count.
**Don't** round slanted controls beyond 2px or cards beyond 4px.
**Don't** set paragraphs in the narrow italic display voice.
**Don't** introduce a second display family or system display faces; everything is Saira.
**Don't** hand-pick a text color for a team color.
